text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm beat!
I'm totally exhausted...!
choice_data_list: You did great, Heart!!
You did so well, Heart!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daring Heart collapsed onto the turf, breathing with all her might. I applauded with everything I had for her, who gave her absolute all to the very limit—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san, are you okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay...
Just let me stay like this... a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Understood...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait—Hey!
Why don't you two lie down too?
It feels amazing~!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, that looks fun!
Do you mind if I join you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, what...!?
T-Then...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Siiigh............
Hey, Craft, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That was an absolute blast!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad to have been born in the same era as everyone.
I'm so glad... I got to run together with you all!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Because everyone's hearts were truly strong...
I was able to match them with the exact same passion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft's wish to connect to others.
Messiah's desire to succeed her mother...
Both of them were simply marvelous!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accepting me for who I am.
To me, the days spent with everyone are—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It's the greatest treasure—a true treasure!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's keep running together. As far as we can go... the two of usâ

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—We can show off
the radiance of the Tiara even more!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
!
Yes, that's right...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let us keep running.
As long as this heart continues to cry out—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
............
Inherited feelings.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see. So I... can carry it on too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The strength endowed to this body by Mother.
Someday, I will pass it on to someone...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Welcome back. ...How did it go?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it was intensely hard!
So hard I almost regretted starting to run!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still—that's precisely why it was so much fun!
Trainer, I... I had a blast!
choice_data_list: Yeah— it came through loud and clear.
Yeah—I hear you loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that right!
Your cheeks are turning... hot, too.
choice_data_list: Watching you run makes my heart burn with excitement.
Because watching you run makes my heart burn with passion

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Running through this past year... I've come to think.
Maybe strength is about having
an unshakeable core.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft, Messiah, Cesario.
Every one of you has an unshakeable conviction.
Pitting them against each other—that's what makes it so fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is my youth—
My youth. Everything I seek right now...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I want to hone this heart and keep running soul-stirring races with my rivals... from here on out!
choice_data_list: So that's your dream right now.
So that's your dream right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! So in the next race, too...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa there.
choice_data_list: Are you okay?
Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
That was far too exhausting, even for me...
choice_data_list: Let's take a break and rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That means... our next target race
won't be until the Senior Class, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod and ponder. A plan where Daring Heart
can get plenty of rest while still fulfilling her wish
of facing her rivals would be—
choice_data_list: Early April, the GII Hanshin Uma Musume Stakes

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
! A 1600m mile race...
I'm sure Craft will enter too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do that!
In fact, that's even better...!
choice_data_list: Craft is a special rival, after all.
Craft is a special rival, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: YES!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
In the Senior Class too, we'll be clashing with that girl—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart murmured with heartfelt joy.
And so, her next target race was decided as the Hanshin Uma Musume Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the fierce battle of the Shuka Sho.
Taking a leisurely walk through town to help Daring Heart refresh herself—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
That girl...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey!!
âTact~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hello, Heart-san.
choice_data_list: You're...
You are...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's Daring Tact!
My favorite junior♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!
Was this... a favorite of yours...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, that reaction...
Don't tell me you don't want to?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
N-No way!
If anything, I'm overly honored...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I found it a little surprising. Daring Heart has plenty of friends and is admired by her juniors. However, I've never seen her play favorites with anyone in particular.
choice_data_list: Where did you meet?
Where did you two meet?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Deep in the mountains! 
She was doing some survival training too.
choice_data_list: I see, so you two really hit it off.
I see, so you two really hit it off.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes. Ever since then, Heart-san and I have gotten along quite well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Honestly though, when it comes to survival, she's
one step ahead of me. I have a lot to learn from her!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
By the way... from the looks of it,
were you searching for fish?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: That's right. There are a lot of fish here that aren't back home... Oh, that reminds me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san, do you know what kind of fish that is?
Um, the one with slightly pointy fins...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that girl!
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart and Daring Tact.
Seeing how close they were
left a lingering impression on me—
